data.title: Manual search success does not prove automated cell stability
data.summary: The bounded pilot had four dispatched requests, three returned responses and one complete native non-baseline proposal evaluation. Full cycle timestamps and operator intervention counts are missing. Restart retained the baseline but skipped unfinished generation one.
data.claim_ceiling: Historical pilot and recovery evidence, not all champion history.
data.strongest_falsifier: Two consecutive verified generations including interruption recovery with zero operator routing.
data.ablation_failure: Without expected-generation and verifier-ACK checks, a zero exit code can falsely certify completion.

data.title: Quota observation restored without enabling inference
data.summary: The authenticated quota-only route returned 200 and rejected unauthorized GET and authenticated POST. It observed Kimi allowance without a model call.
data.claim_ceiling: Quota observation only, not automatic account-wide enforcement or a completed evolutionary cycle.
data.strongest_falsifier: Authorized GET fails or an inference request is admitted through the meter route.
data.ablation_failure: The legacy inference pause blocked quota observation and produced a misleading local 503.

data.title: Persistent installation held after approval rejection
data.summary: Source guard and automatic approval review prevented persistent installation. A timing-sensitive concurrency fixture also failed; no failed run was reported as green.
data.claim_ceiling: Cached responses, isolated VPS library copy, harness-driven replacement, separate geometry code. No live inference, production readiness, cross-host fencing, independent security principal or new champion.
data.strongest_falsifier: Resume repeats a proposal request, admits changed task bytes, omits a generation or promotes invalid geometry.
data.ablation_failure: Prior runner skipped an unfinished directory; earlier cancellation permitted dispatch after stop acknowledgement.
